dominion.of.canada.unoffical: Pavel Unoffical reached S-C9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-C9, Pavel Unoffical listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Pavel Unoffical ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Unoffical is number 648. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C9. Pavel Unoffical has learned to walk bent double.
Pavel Unoffical and Anselm "Brick" Squid tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Pavel Unoffical put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Pavel Unoffical took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
Pavel Unoffical took the long way round Saint-Ash crossroads because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
The guns hit S-C9 hard. Pavel Unoffical came out of it with a shattered arm and burns along one side of his face.
galactic_racoon: On Day 11 Ivo Racoon took a post at U-F3 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Ivo Racoon could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
On a quiet night Jonas Witcombe (Concord) and Ivo Racoon (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of U-F3. When Ivo Racoon challenged it, there was nobody there.
Ivo Racoon brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Thunder shook dust from the beams over Ivo Racoon. For once, nobody blamed the enemy.
Ivo Racoon was on watch at U-F3 when the night raid hit. The men found Ivo Racoon at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Dietrich Dagata of the Concord (@anthony.dagata).
A letter came with Henrik Racoon: "I am Ivo Racoon's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
imerv2: On Day 8 Isidor "Saint" Imerv took a post at R-S17 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
Casimir Nile and Isidor "Saint" Imerv argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

Isidor "Saint" Imerv was carrying water up to R-S17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Isidor "Saint" Imerv did not. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated). Isidor "Saint" Imerv smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. Isidor "Saint" Imerv was hit at R-S17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor of the Hegemony (@andyincorporated).
The papers connected Jakub "Bones" Imerv to Isidor "Saint" Imerv. The men took longer to learn Jakub "Bones" Imerv's own habits, but they made the effort.

Jakub "Bones" Imerv was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Gideon Jesh of the Hegemony (@jesh20000). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub "Bones" Imerv answered to number 594. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jakub "Bones" Imerv watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The wound on Jakub "Bones" Imerv's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Jakub "Bones" Imerv and Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
The cook's fire went out. Jakub "Bones" Imerv relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Jakub "Bones" Imerv across the shin at R-S17. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Gustav Mondo of the Hegemony (@il_migliore_al_mondo).
The medics cleaned Jakub "Bones" Imerv's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-S17.
jarbeefus_kong: Casimir Kong, a lamplighter from Halden, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Casimir Kong was hit in the hip at T-F10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Pavel Volna of the Concord (@vonya_volna). Casimir Kong looked over the parapet at T-F10 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Pavel Volna of the Concord (@vonya_volna).

Bram "Mole" Kong asked about Casimir Kong on arriving at T-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bram "Mole" Kong helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The trench wall shook against Bram "Mole" Kong's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Oskar Mateescu owes Bram "Mole" Kong so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Bram "Mole" Kong polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Bram "Mole" Kong had just lit a cigarette at T-F10 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jakub "Ash" Baron of the Concord (@butter_baron468).
Bram "Mole" Kong's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
joseph_austin15_: Emil "Spark" Austin arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Emil "Spark" Austin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Emil "Spark" Austin held the mirror while Cyril "Mud" Sann shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Emil "Spark" Austin got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 643. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Emil "Spark" Austin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A newspaper reached Emil "Spark" Austin with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Emil "Spark" Austin and Felix "Parson" Theman compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Arno Toastyy stood up to sing louder, and Emil "Spark" Austin fired. Arno Toastyy was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
Emil "Spark" Austin drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The salvo walked along S-C10 and caught Emil "Spark" Austin in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.
monsterjohn: By the time Cyril Monsterjohn reached V-F19, the war was 12 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Cyril Monsterjohn wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Cyril Monsterjohn went out with the wiring party at V-F19. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
A rat stole Cyril Monsterjohn's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
The sergeant at V-F19 called out a range and a spot. Cyril Monsterjohn was the only one who hit it. Cyril "Owl" Man was grazed.
oliversheppard1: Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa found a place in T-S7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa carried three men out of T-S7 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa held the mirror while Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa ate two helpings anyway.
Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa of the Concord and Yann Zannwaffen of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep.
The last report placed Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa near Grey Mill. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
Still no sign of Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa. Some say he was taken prisoner. Some say he got lost in the old trenches. Nobody says the other thing.
